about_short_description.short_description: EthonAI is an AI-powered platform that detects and prevents manufacturing defects.

product.name: Analyst
product.description: Software that identifies root causes of production losses by analyzing thousands of process parameters.

product.name: Inspector
product.description: Software that detects visual defects such as assembly errors and surface imperfections using industrial cameras.

product.name: Observer
product.description: Software that provides real-time process monitoring combined with data exploration capabilities.

product.name: Tracker
product.description: Software that provides access to detailed production history, including routing, process data, and inspection images for each product.

product.name: Miner
product.description: Software that analyzes material flows using process mining algorithms to identify bottlenecks, variations, and excess inventory.

product.name: Console
product.description: A low-code environment for custom data exploration, code execution, and visualization within manufacturing analytics.
